stops.note: a legendary substance alchemists sought to turn base metal into gold
Arabic 'al-iksir', from Greek 'xērion', a drying powder for wounds; alchemists sought an elixir of life
Chaucer's Canon's Yeoman speaks of the alchemists' 'elixir' around 1386, in the lab vocabulary that reached English from Arabic through Latin

current_meaning: a magical potion believed to cure ailments or grant eternal life
